title: Infrastructure as Code
description: Declarative provisioning, drift detection and reviewable infrastructure changes.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can explain what distinguishes declarative infrastructure-as-code from an imperative setup script, and can run an existing plan/apply cycle with guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can write a small, working infrastructure-as-code definition for a scoped piece of infrastructure and apply it from a clean state with limited guidance.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently design, modularize and apply an infrastructure-as-code definition for a multi-resource stack, and can explain every resource it creates.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can detect drift between declared and actual infrastructure state, and can defend a chosen remediation path (revert, import, or codify) under mentor questioning.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can design a reviewable infrastructure-change workflow, with plan output and policy checks surfaced before apply, and can teach a peer how to safely evolve shared infrastructure code.
